dataset.dataset: MM-Fi: balanced cohort of 20 subjects and 27 actions
dataset.consent_basis: The MM-Fi authors report signed participant consent and NTU approval IRB-2022-1067; this use is noncommercial research.
dataset.scope_note: The 40-subject expansion is blocked by a verified Google Drive quota response. This cohort includes only the 20 subjects with complete recordings for all 27 actions.
dataset.coordinate_note: A declared 640 by 640 annotation reference plane preserves isotropic pixel geometry. It is not recovered camera calibration.
dataset.label_note: Supplied 2D keypoints, not independently manually audited; no RGB images loaded.

evidence_basis: Compiled from raw_frame_hashes computed by the importer while reading original source files. No second source-byte or prepared-NPZ verification pass is claimed here. Training/audit separately verifies prepared file hashes.
hash_convention: Sort E/S/A sequence IDs lexically; within each sequence sort numeric frame IDs. For each frame append CSI then RGB records: UTF-8 relative_path<TAB>sha256<LF>. Hash the concatenated records using SHA-256.

label_observations.purpose: all27actions balanced20subject cohort after upstream quota blocked remainingpeople
